# Test data

## When name a tag

- **take the static fields name** — `_staticField.Name is "_staticField"`
- **an explicit name, then use it** — `New Tag<int>("chosen").Name is "chosen"`
- **take the instance fields name** — `_instanceField.Name is "_instanceField"`
- **no name at all, then number it** — `New Tag<int>(null).Name starts with "Tag_"`
- **built outside a field initializer, then take the enclosing members name**\
  `BuiltInAMethod().Name is nameof BuiltInAMethod`
- **one declaration, then name each after its own variable**
  ```
  _first.Name is "_first"
  _second.Name is "_second"
  ```

## When tag names collide
```
Subject under test: int
Return type: int
```

- **two tags declared in a method, then setup failed names the clash**
  ```
  When the One + the Two
  Ex.Message starts with "Two tags are named '{nameof
      GivenTwoTagsDeclaredInAMethod_ThenSetupFailedNamesTheClash}'."
      and contains "Name each one where it is declared"
  ```
- **tags of different types share a name, then setup failed all the same**
  ```
  Given Text is "x"
    and Number is 1
  ```
- **each is named, then both are accepted**
  ```
  Given High is 2
    and Low is 1
  When the Low + the High
  Then Result is 3
  ```

# Internal

## Document

### When derive subject name

- **nothing to strip, then fail** — *TODO: Assert behaviour*
- **a suffix, then strip the last one**\
  `SpecificationSubject.DeriveName(specAssemblyName) is expected`

### When digest subject source

- **state eight hex characters** — `Digest([.. _implementation]) matches "^[0-9a-f]{8}$"`
- **a real assembly, then state an id for it**\
  `SourceDigest.Of(typeof(Spec).Assembly.Location) matches "^[0-9a-f]{8}$"`
- **no debug information, then state nothing**\
  `SourceDigest.Of(Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "no-such-assembly.dll")) is null`
- **ignore the order the compiler listed them in**\
  `Digest([.. _implementation]) is digest [_implementation[1], _implementation[0]]`
- **move when an implementation file changes**
  ```
  Digest([.. _implementation]) is not
      digest [new(_implementation[0].Path, "999999"), _implementation[1]]
  ```
- **ignore what the build generated into obj**
  ```
  Digest([.. _implementation, AssemblyInfoAt("89837352")]) is
      Digest([.. _implementation, AssemblyInfoAt("191c2bc7")])
  ```
- **move when a file is added**
  ```
  Digest([.. _implementation]) is not
      Digest([.. _implementation, new(@"C:\src\MyHotel\Core\Rooms\Room.cs", "7a8b9c")])
  ```
- **a real assembly, then read what the compiler recorded**
  ```
  SourceDigest.Read(typeof(Spec).Assembly.Location) has some
      file.Path.EndsWith("SourceDigest.cs", StringComparison.Ordinal)
  ```
- **ignore where the project was built**
  ```
  Digest([.. _implementation]) is digest [new(
      "/home/dev/MyHotel/Core/Rooms/RoomService.cs", "1a2b3c"),
      new("/home/dev/MyHotel/Core/Rooms/IRoomStore.cs", "4d5e6f")]
  ```
- **a real assembly, then the generated files are there to exclude**
  ```
  SourceDigest.Read(typeof(Spec).Assembly.Location) has some file.Path.Contains("\obj\",
      StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || file.Path.Contains("/obj/",
      StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
  ```

### When list expected requirements

- **exclude a skipped test**\
  `Lists SkippedSample { nameof SkippedSample.ThenNeverRuns } is false`
- **include a runnable test**\
  `Lists WhenListExpectedRequirements { nameof ThenIncludeARunnableTest } is true`
- **include a test inherited by a concrete class**\
  `Lists ConcreteSample { nameof AbstractSample.ThenOnlyRunsViaASubclass } is true`
- **exclude an abstract spec**\
  `Lists AbstractSample { nameof AbstractSample.ThenOnlyRunsViaASubclass } is false`
- **nothing reported, then every requirement is missing**\
  `SpecificationCollector.Missing(new HashSet<string> { "A.b", "A.a" }) is equal to ["A.a", "A.b"]`

### When locate project directory

- **the directory itself holds one, then find it**\
  `ProjectDirectory.Locate(project.Root) is project.Root`
- **find the nearest ancestor holding a project file**\
  `ProjectDirectory.Locate(project.BaseDirectory) is project.Root`

### When parse project references

- **read their version** — `Version is "0.1.0"`
- **an unknown subject, then reach nothing** — `Closure "Other" is empty`
- **keep direct project references** — `Parse().TryGetVersion("MyHotel", out _) is true`
- **drop package references** — `Parse().TryGetVersion("xunit.v3", out _) is false`
- **drop transitive project references**\
  `Parse().TryGetVersion("MyHotel.Persistence", out _) is false`
- **reach everything the subject is built on**\
  `Closure "MyHotel" is equal to ["MyHotel", "MyHotel.Persistence"]`
- **start where it is asked**\
  `Closure "MyHotel.Persistence" is equal to ["MyHotel.Persistence"]`
- **an unknown assembly, then find nothing**\
  `ProjectReferences.Parse(DepsJson.MyHotelSpec, "Other").Names.Count is 0`
- **stop at packages**
  ```
  Closure "MyHotel.Spec" does not contain "xunit.v3"
      and not contain "TSpec"
  ```

### When prepare document

- **no project file, then fail** — *TODO: Assert behaviour*
- **no dependency manifest, then fail** — `Error.Message contains "MyHotel.Spec.deps.json"`
- **write what it prepared** — `File.ReadAllText(document.Path) is document.Render([])`
- **the subject carries no debug information, then state only its version**
  ```
  PendingDocument.Prepare("MyHotel.Spec", project.BaseDirectory).Render([]) contains
      "Version 0.1.0, generated by TSpec"
  ```
- **render the subject it resolved**
  ```
  PendingDocument.Prepare("MyHotel.Spec", project.BaseDirectory).Render([]) contains "# My Hotel"
      and contains "Version 0.1.0"
  ```
- **target the project root**
  ```
  PendingDocument.Prepare("MyHotel.Spec", project.BaseDirectory).Path is
      Path.Combine(project.Root, "SPECIFICATION.md")
  ```
- **identify the source the subject was built from**
  ```
  PendingDocument.Prepare("MyHotel.Spec", project.BaseDirectory).Render([]) contains
      "Version 0.1.0+{SourceDigest.Of(subject)},"
  ```
- **identify the source of everything below the subject**
  ```
  PendingDocument.Prepare("MyHotel.Spec", project.BaseDirectory).Render([]) contains
      "Version 0.1.0+{SourceDigest.Of([subject, below])},"
  ```

### When read declared types

- **no type arguments, then read nothing** — `Declares typeof NoSubject is null`
- **read both type arguments** — `Declares typeof Subject is ("MyModel", "int")`
- **a nested branch, then read what it inherits**\
  `Declares typeof Outer.GivenSomething is ("MyModel", "int")`
- **one type argument, then read it as both**\
  `Declares typeof SubjectIsAlsoTheResult is ("MyModel", "MyModel")`
- **neither is used, then read nothing**\
  `TestIdentity.Declares(typeof(Subject), actsOnSubject: false, yieldsResult: false) is null`
- **the act takes no subject, then read only the return type**
  ```
  TestIdentity.Declares(typeof(Subject), actsOnSubject: false, yieldsResult: true) is (null, "int")
  ```
- **the act yields nothing, then read only the subject**
  ```
  TestIdentity.Declares(typeof(Subject), actsOnSubject: true, yieldsResult: false) is
      ("MyModel", null)
  ```

### When render document

- **no entries, then render the header alone** — `Render() is Header`
- **name the build the document came from** — `Render() contains "Version 0.1.0+4f2a9c1e"`
- **a requirement is nothing but the shared opening, then leave the opening in place**\
  `Render requirements contains "-->\n\n---\n\n## "`
- **duplicate entries, then render one**\
  `Render _respondOk, _respondOk is render _respondOk`
- **the spec declares nothing, then say nothing about types**\
  `Render _respondOk does not contain "Subject under test"`
- **a heading states one label alone, then still write it with one space**\
  `Render OneSubjectManyReturnTypes() does not contain "Return type:  "`
- **the document states the subject, then do not repeat it per subject**\
  `Render(OneSubjectManyReturnTypes()).Split("Subject under test").Length is 2`
- **every requirement opens alike, then state that once for the document**\
  `Render TwoSubjects() contains "Do not edit by hand. -->\n`Using api`\n\n---\n\n## When add room"`
- **no branch, then list the requirement under the subject**
  ```
  Render _respondOk with { Branch = "" } contains "## When get version\n\n- **respond ok**\n"
      and not contain "###"
  ```
- **normalise line endings to lf**
  ```
  Render _respondOk with { Clauses = sentences "when a", "then b" } contains "When a\n  Then b"
      and not contain "\r"
  ```
- **a requirement claims nothing, then say it is still to do**
  ```
  Render requirement "WhenGetRoom", "ThenAuthorizeRequest" contains
      "- **authorize request** — *TODO: Assert behaviour*\n"
  ```
- **a dotted subject name, then title it as one name**
  ```
  DocumentRenderer.Render(new("MyHotel.Core", "0.1.0"), "MyHotel.Core.Spec", "4f2a9c1e", [])
      starts with "# My Hotel Core\n"
  ```
- **a single requirement, then still state its opening above**
  ```
  Render(TwoSubjects()[..1]) contains "-->\n`Using api`\n"
      and contains "## When get room\n`get`\n"
      and contains "- **Thena** — `a`\n"
  ```
- **two requirements open alike, then state the opening once**

  Render(TwoSubjects()[..2]) contains "-->\n`Using api`\n"
      and contains "## When get room\n`get`\n"
      and contains "- **Thena** — `a`\n"
  ```
- **one subject opens alike, then state that once for the subject**

  Render TwoSubjects() contains "## When add room\n`post`\n"
      and contains "## When get room\n`get`\n"
      and contains "- **Thena** — `a`\n"
  ```

  Render _respondOk with { SubjectUnderTest = "Hotel" } contains

  ```

      .When(s.Counter).Then().Result

- **the inner setup fails, then the outer reaches the cause**

## Having when until
```
Subject under test: CounterSpec
Return type: int
```

- **call then before when, then throw setup failed**
  ```
  When Then().Result
  Then throws SetupFailed
  ```
- **when executed twice, then throw setup failed**\
  `When when ++s.Counter.When(Counter *= 2).Then().Result`
- **is executed before when**
  ```
  When when ++s.Counter.Having(s.Counter++).Then().Result
  Then Result is 2
    and Specification is " When ++Counter Having Counter++ Then "
  ```
- **until executed twice, both are executed**
  ```
  When when Counter = 1.Until(Counter = 3).Until(Counter = 2).Then().Result
  Then Result is 1
    and Specification is " When Counter = 1 Until Counter = 3 before Counter = 2 Then "
  ```
- **First having is executed after second having before when**
  ```
  When when Counter *= 2.Having(Counter = 3).Having(Counter = 5).Then().Result
  Then Result is 6
    and Specification is " When Counter *= 2 Having Counter = 3 after Counter = 5 Then "
  ```
- **steps declared out of order, then specify them in pipeline order**
  ```
  When when ++s.Counter.Until(++s.Counter).Using(1).Having(s.Counter++).Then().Result
  Then Result is 2
    and Specification is " Using 1 When ++Counter Having Counter++ Until ++Counter Then "
  ```
- **setup fail, then dont tear down**
  ```
  When Given().A<MyModel>(m => throw new ApplicationException()).When(s =>
      s.Counter).Until(void (s) => throw new InvalidOperationException("Unexpected
      exception")).Then().Result
  Then throws SetupFailed that InnerException is a ApplicationException
  ```

- **first model has setup** — `Result[0].Id is the first MyModel's Id`
- **second model has setup** — `Result[1].Id is the second MyModel's Id`

### Given two items with transform
`two MyModels with Id = 123`

- **first model has setup** — `Result[0].Id is the first MyModel's Id`
- **second model has setup** — `Result[1].Id is the second MyModel's Id`

### Given two with setup
`two MyModels with Id = an int`

- **two with setup, then apply setup to returned array** — `Result has all m.Id == the int`

### Given zero
`zero MyModels`

- **returned array has zero elements** — `Result.Length is 0`

### Given mention of any array, followed by, mention of array of specific length
```
Using MyModel with Name = a string
  and two MyModels
```

- **get array of specific length**
  ```
  Result is two MyModels
    and Result.First().Name is the string
  ```

## When given array of values
```
Subject under test: MyService
Return type: IEnumerable<int>
```

- **can use two values given separately from mock**

  Using two ints
  When GetIds()
  Then Result is two ints
  ```
- **do not use two values given in different setup**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Values = two ints
  When GetIds()
  Then Result is empty
  ```
- **get enumerable on model, given two values, then return two values**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Values = two ints
  When GetModel().Values
  Then Result is two ints
  ```
- **model has some values, and given one value, then model has one value**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Values = some ints
    and one int
  When GetModel().Values
  Then Result is one int
  ```
- **model has many values, and given zero values, then model has three values**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Values = many ints
    and zero ints
  When GetModel().Values
  Then Result has count 3
  ```
- **model has some values, and given zero values, then model has two values**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Values = some ints
    and zero ints
  When GetModel().Values
  Then Result has count 2
  ```
- **model has any no values, and given two values, then model has two values**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Values = any number of ints
    and two ints
  When GetModel().Values
  Then Result is two ints
  ```

## When given setup model with default
```
Subject under test: MyService
Return type: MyModel
```

- **default with auto mock**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Name = DefaultName
  When GetModel()
  Then Result.Name is DefaultName
  ```
- **provide default setup after model is used in when, then use setup**
  ```
  Using DefaultName
  Given IMyRepository.GetModel() returns a second MyModel
  When GetModel()
  Then Result.Name is DefaultName
  ```
- **default not overridden**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Name = DefaultName
  Given IMyRepository.GetModel() returns a second MyModel
  When GetModel()
  Then Result.Name is DefaultName
  ```
- **model, referenced as input twice, and with default setup, then use default setup**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Id = 123
  Given IMyRepository.SetModel(the MyModel) returns another MyModel
  When MyService.Echo(a MyModel)
  Then Result.Id is 123
  ```
- **default is not overridden**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Name = DefaultName
  Given IMyRepository.GetModel() returns the MyModel
  When MyService.Echo(a MyModel)
  Then Result.Name is DefaultName
  ```
- **default value and default setup**
  ```
  Using DefaultName
    and MyModel with Name = a string
  Given IMyRepository.GetModel() returns a second MyModel
  When GetModel()
  Then Result.Name is DefaultName
  ```
- **two default setups, then apply second**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Name = "123"
    and MyModel with Name = DefaultName
  Given IMyRepository.GetModel() returns a second MyModel
  When GetModel()
  Then Result.Name is DefaultName
  ```
- **two different default setups, then apply both**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Id = 123
    and MyModel with Name = DefaultName
  Given IMyRepository.GetModel() returns a second MyModel
  When GetModel()
  Then Result.Name is DefaultName
    and Result.Id is 123
  ```
- **default is overridden**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Name = DefaultName
  Given a second MyModel with Name = "Altered"
    and IMyRepository.GetModel() returns a second MyModel
  When GetModel()
  Then Result.Name is "Altered"
  ```
- **default is replaced**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Name = DefaultName
  Given a second MyModel is new MyModel() { Name = "My model" }
    and IMyRepository.GetModel() returns a second MyModel
  When GetModel()
  Then Result.Name is "My model"
  ```

## When given static model

- **no subject returns value**
  ```
  Using 0
  When () => A<MyModel>()
  Then Result is the MyModel
  ```
- **default setup, then use default setup on SUT**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Name = value
  When _
  Then Result.Name is value
  ```
- **no subject action**
  ```
  Using 0
  When () => { model = A<MyModel>(); }
  Then model is the MyModel
  ```
- **default setup, then use default setup on a value**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Name = value
  When a MyModel
  Then Result.Name is value
  ```
- **no subject returns value async**
  ```
  Using 0
  When () => Task.FromResult(A<MyModel>())
  Then Result is the MyModel
  ```
- **setup fifth model, then apply setup on, the fifth model**
  ```
  Given a fifth MyModel with Name = name
  When the fifth MyModel
  Then Result.Name is name
  ```
- **setup third model, then apply setup on, the third model**
  ```
  Given a third MyModel with Name = name
  When the third MyModel
  Then Result.Name is name
  ```
- **setup fourth model, then apply setup on, the fourth model**
  ```
  Given a fourth MyModel with Name = name
  When the fourth MyModel
  Then Result.Name is name
  ```
- **setup second model, then apply setup on, the second model**
  ```
  Given a second MyModel with Name = name
  When the second MyModel
  Then Result.Name is name
  ```
- **no subject action async**
  ```
  Using 0
  When () => { model = A<MyModel>(); return Task.CompletedTask; }
  Then model is the MyModel
  ```
- **two default setup, then apply both**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Name = name
    and MyModel with Id = id
  When _
  Then Result.Name is name
    and Result.Id is id
  ```
- **default setup and model, then use default setup on model**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Name = name
    and new MyModel { Id = id }
  When _
  Then Result.Name is name
    and Result.Id is id
  ```
- **default setup overridden by specific setup, then use specific setup on the model**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Name = defaultName
  Given a MyModel with Name = name
  When the MyModel
  Then Result.Name is name
  ```
- **default setup and specific setup, then use both setups on the model**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Name = name
  Given a MyModel with Id = id
  When the MyModel
  Then Result.Name is name
    and Result.Id is id
  ```
- **default setup and a model, then not use default setup on the model**
  ```
  Using MyModel with Name = name
  Given a MyModel is new MyModel { Id = id }
  When the MyModel
  Then Result.Name is null
    and Result.Id is id
  ```
